formats.scorm12.title: SCORM 1.2
formats.scorm12.subtitle: Legacy Standard
formats.scorm12.description: E-learning standard for learning management systems. Widely used, but older. Suitable for legacy LMS platforms. Learn more
formats.scorm2004.title: SCORM 2004
formats.scorm2004.subtitle: Modern Standard
formats.scorm2004.description: Modern version of the SCORM standard with advanced features for learning paths and assessments. Recommended for current LMS systems. Learn more
formats.ims.title: IMS
formats.ims.subtitle: Content Package
formats.ims.description: IMS Content Packaging for exchanging learning content between different platforms. Standard for cross-platform compatibility. Learn more
formats.web.title: Web
formats.web.subtitle: Standalone
formats.web.description: Standalone HTML website for hosting on any web server. Works offline and online. Perfect for self-hosting.
formats.pdf.title: PDF
formats.pdf.subtitle: Document
formats.pdf.description: Portable Document Format for printing and archiving. Ideal for static content and offline reading. Learn more
formats.android.title: Android
formats.android.subtitle: App Package
formats.android.description: Android app package (APK) for installation on Android devices. Enables offline access and native app experience.
formats.notice.unavailable.text: This format cannot be exported in the browser. Use the Docker image instead.
formats.notice.largeCourses.text: For very large courses we recommend the desktop app — the browser may run out of memory.
formats.json.title: JSON
formats.json.subtitle: Data Export
formats.json.description: Structured data format for programmatic processing and API integration. Perfect for developers and automated workflows. Learn more
formats.epub.title: EPUB
formats.epub.subtitle: E-Book
formats.epub.description: Open e-book format for e-readers and mobile devices. Supports reflowable layouts and is compatible with most e-readers. Learn more
formats.docx.title: DOCX
formats.docx.subtitle: Word Document
formats.docx.description: Microsoft Word document format for professional documents. Compatible with Word 2007+, LibreOffice Writer, and Google Docs. Learn more
formats.rdf.title: RDF
formats.rdf.subtitle: Metadata
formats.rdf.description: Resource Description Framework for structured metadata and Linked Data. For semantic web applications and metadata export. Learn more
formats.xapi.title: xAPI
formats.xapi.subtitle: Learning Analytics
formats.xapi.description: Experience API (xAPI) for Learning Analytics and detailed tracking of learning activities. Enables advanced analytics through a Learning Record Store (LRS). Learn more

submit.errorNoGitUrl: Please enter a Git repository URL.
submit.busy: Another export ({jobId}) has not finished yet. This version runs one export at a time, and only while its status page is open — open it to let it finish, or discard it there.
modal.title: Export Started
modal.successMessage: Your export has been successfully added to the queue.
status.title: Export Status
status.subtitle: Track the status of your export job
status.noExportMessage: Start a new export on the home page.
status.downloadReady: Your export is ready for download!
status.printHint: The course opens in a new tab and the print dialog appears — choose "Save as PDF" as the destination.
status.printBlocked: The print tab was blocked. Please allow pop-ups for this page and try again.
status.resultGone: This export is no longer available — the file is kept only while the page stays open. Please export again.
status.discardConfirm: Discard this export? A new export can then be started. If it is already running in this tab it cannot be stopped: it keeps using the tab until it ends and its result is thrown away. Reload the page to stop it sooner.
status.discardFailed: The export could not be discarded
errors.zip.noMarkdown: No markdown file found in "{file}". Please include a README.md or any .md file.
errors.assets.unsupportedFormat: "{format}" cannot be exported in the browser
errors.assets.loadFailed: could not load the "{bundle}" assets ({status} from {url})
errors.github.rateLimitUntil: GitHub's hourly limit for anonymous requests is used up. It resets at {time} — or download the repository and upload it instead.
errors.github.rateLimit: GitHub's hourly limit for anonymous requests is used up. Try again later, or download the repository and upload it instead.
errors.github.noBranch: Could not find branch or tag "{branch}" in "{repo}". Check the branch name, or leave it empty to use the default branch.
errors.github.noRepo: Could not find "{repo}". Check the address — private repositories cannot be read from the browser.
errors.github.forbidden: GitHub refused access to "{repo}"{detail}. Private repositories cannot be read from the browser.
errors.github.fileTooLarge: "{path}" is {size}, over the {limit} limit for a single file.
errors.github.courseTooLarge: This course is {size}, over the {limit} limit. The largest files are: {files}. Export it with the desktop app or the command line instead.
errors.github.notGitHub: Only GitHub repositories can be imported in the browser. Download the course and upload it instead.
errors.github.badUrl: Could not read a repository from "{url}". Expected something like "https://github.com/owner/repo".
errors.github.unreachable: Could not reach GitHub. Check the network connection and try again.
errors.github.tooManyFiles: "{repo}" is too large for GitHub to list in one request, so some files would be missing. Download it and upload it instead.
errors.github.emptySubdir: Nothing found in "{subdir}" — check the subdirectory.
errors.github.emptyRepo: "{repo}" holds no files that can be exported.
errors.github.noSuchFile: "{file}" was not found in the repository.
errors.github.noMarkdown: No markdown file found in "{where}". A course needs a README.md or another .md file.
errors.upload.noFile: Please choose a course file to export.
errors.upload.noMarkdown: No markdown file found. Please choose a .md course file, or a .zip containing one.
errors.export.serverOnly: "{format}" needs the export service — it cannot run in a browser.
